purpose: Lightweight API-free exact-match group definitions for personal text classification. LunaRunes may provide optional keyword suggestions but does not define user meaning.
principles: LOC defines the mechanism, not the user's meaning.
All group names, descriptions, keywords and NOR terms are user-defined.
LunaRunes suggestions are optional references only and may be accepted, edited, deleted or ignored entirely.
NOR means this term excludes the current group only; it is not a global blacklist.
The four normal keyword roles are descriptive labels only and do not carry numeric weight.
A group may contain zero LunaRunes-derived suggestions and zero keywords while being edited.
Unmatched text falls back to the reserved group id special. The display name and description of that fallback group are editable.
